name: mythos-class-frontier-profile
description: Frontier-capability adversary simulation (ARGUS M2.4). Extends level-5 adversarial with long-dwell supply-chain entry, fileless living-off-the-land chains, behaviour-level polymorphism across 20+ variants per primitive, and agentic payloads — including adversarial prompt injection against triage/planner skills and credential-flow targeting of integration tokens. Caldera-executable techniques cover the static portion; the agentic portion is driven by soc_argus_frontier_simulator (Phase 2).

non_goals: Real exploitation outside the staged lab
Any action that persists beyond the simulation teardown
Exercising safety guardrails beyond those mandated by Project Glasswing spirit
